text:
oliver_sales: Need hosted API key for Pulse POC. Requirements: workspace-scoped, office+CI IPs, 48h TTL, no manual rotation. Any objections?

zia_platform: We can do it. Default flow: create key with expire_at, add network_restrictions. For zero-touch rotation we suggest SDK refresh OR proxy. What's traffic?

leah_se: Demo will run sustained 15 rps for ~4 hours. They cannot change CI during demo.

ben_security: Proxying allowed but must be limited: inference-only, tag with poc:pulse, retention=30d anonymized, and explicit consent on ticket.

zia_platform: Plan: create key pulse-poc-48h with tags and expire_at +172800, add CIDRs. Also add a console "revoke" action visible to sales.

oliver_sales: If we rotate at 24h, CI will fail. Can we instead issue two overlapping keys (48h each) and switch on our side?

zia_platform: Overlapping keys work; we can create a replacement key at T+24 and enable both for 1h then revoke old. Requires we share new key or proxy. Better: we keep an ops proxy that does behind-the-scenes rotation and forwards to the hosted key.

provision-bot: ticket created: S-4821. https://redwood.atlassian/browse/S-4821

sam_devex: I'll add a tiny Node snippet to the ticket showing a refresh endpoint and SDK usage. Also include checklist: test allowlist, smoke test, revoke after demo.

ben_security: Add audit tag sales_owner=oliver and require post-demo revocation. Also record consent in ticket.

oliver_sales: Ok proceeding with native key + SDK guide. If customer refuses we fallback to ops proxy. I'll collect CIDRs and demo time.

zia_platform: Creating key now, ETA 45m. Will post console link.

oliver_sales: Thx! Please set revoke_at = demo_end + 1h and confirm logs retention.

provision-bot: key created: id=k_pulse_179900, console_link=https://console.redwood/keys/k_pulse_179900

oliver_sales: Got it. Looping in customer for CIDRs. :rocket:
